name: FoomLottery Groth16 degenerate-verifier proof forgery
summary: The Groth16 verifier was deployed with gamma and delta set to the same BN254 G2 generator point because the snarkjs Phase 2 contribution was skipped, collapsing proof soundness so anyone can forge withdrawal proofs for fresh nullifiers with C equal to negated vk_x. The anchor creates the exploit contract and loops forged collect calls against the Base lottery; sixteen minutes later the same flaw was exercised against the Ethereum lottery and those proceeds were returned the same day.

loss.notes: Gross pre-recovery victim depletion across both chains: 4,588,196,709,631.799956807157941481 FOOM leaves the Base lottery in the anchor and 19,695,576,757,802.192910518134117126 FOOM leaves the Ethereum lottery in the rescue transaction, together about 24.28T FOOM reported at $2.26M. The $1.84M whitehat return executed hours later is not netted out. FOOM is illiquid and realized disposals cleared at discounts, so the USD splits are reported estimates; duha retains the Base share under a disputed bounty claim.

ageReset.description: The verifier is an immutable direct contract whose runtime is byte-identical at deployment and pre-exploit and contains zero DELEGATECALL opcodes. The degenerate gamma-equals-delta verification key is baked in from creation, so deployment is the age reset.

sources.note: Anchor 0xa88317a105155b464118431ce1073d272d8b43e87aba528a24b62075e48d929d is the earliest successful exploit at Base block 42650623 index 59: sender 0x73f55a95d6959d95b3f3f11dDd268ec502dAB1Ea creates executor 0x005299b37703511b35d851e17dd8d4615e8a2c9b in-transaction and loops forged collect calls that move 4,588,196,709,631.799956807157941481 FOOM out of lottery 0xdb203504ba1fea79164af3ceffba88c59ee8aafd. The Ethereum rescue 0xce20448233f5ea6b6d7209cc40b4dc27b65e07728f2cbbfeb29fc0814e275e48 lands sixteen minutes later and moves 19,695,576,757,802.192910518134117126 FOOM out of lottery 0x239af915abcd0a5dcb8566e863088423831951f8, so the Base transaction anchors the single incident owning the two-chain campaign. Root cause is the degenerate verifier key: independent analyses reproduce gamma-equals-delta on both chains from day one, and the public proof-of-concept reads alpha, beta and IC points from the onchain key and forges C as negated vk_x. The aged artifact is the Base verifier 0x02c30d32a92a3c338bc43b78933d293ded4f68c6: top-level creation 0xfe48a01556cb78180f719d60a2c7d7a138eb6e2603b49c3c459778e700cb3070 at block 30882672 index 205 by 0x442de4b67b9cb75f73b33df3b11f694c89f811c2, runtime byte-identical at deployment and pre-exploit blocks, zero DELEGATECALL opcodes and no proxy or upgrade path, making deployment the latest code change and age 23,535,902 seconds. The Ethereum verifier carries the identical flaw and is described through the loss rather than as a second target because verification anchors targets on the incident chain. Loss is gross pre-recovery depletion; the same-day whitehat return is not netted.

limitations: The $2.26M headline and per-chain USD splits are reported estimates over an illiquid token whose disposals cleared at discounts; the structured FOOM quantities are exact onchain.
